data.body:
Root cause per signature, read from the Windows sweep job logs of runs 43820680079, 43871224211 and the b4e0d01b649 scheduled run (2026-11-15/16):

1. Read-only git objects (tests): git writes loose objects and packs read-only; Windows refuses to delete a read-only file (`PermissionError: [WinError 5] Access is denied: '...\.git\objects\b0\45b0...'`). Sites: `tests/interfaces/store/test_event_append_transient_retry.py:318` (`_plant_poison`), `tests/unit/test_authorship_batched_ticket_map_7084.py:517`, `tests/unit/test_pinned_ticket_view.py:674,701,717,765`. `test_ci_snapshot_fixture_cleanup.py::test_completed_snapshot_test_leaves_basetemp_removable` fails the same way inside `shutil.rmtree(basetemp)` on the nested run's `repo\.git\objects\...`, not on the rebar snapshot the test is about.
2. Concurrent replace onto one target (product): `os.replace` raises `PermissionError` (WinError 5) on Windows while another rename or handle holds the target. 5 tests; fixed at class level by sporting-feudalist-bluet (shared `fsutil.replace_with_retry`), which removes those 5 lines.
3. POSIX-only interprocess locks with a fallback that breaks on Windows (product): `src/rebar/_snapshot/git_fetch.py:60-91` `interprocess_lock` uses `fcntl.flock` and otherwise an `os.mkdir` spin-lock; on Windows the `mkdir` of a lock dir another thread is removing raises `PermissionError` (`...\locks\bytes.total.lock.d`, `...\index.sqlite3.recover.lock.d`), failing `test_snapshot_cache.py::test_add_bytes_atomic_under_concurrency` and `test_similar_tickets_index.py::test_only_one_caller_discards_when_two_enter_recovery_on_one_stale_index`. `src/rebar/reconciler/alert_store.py:14-17,51-59` takes no lock at all on Windows, and the CRT's append mode is seek-then-write, so concurrent appends overwrite each other (`Expected 50 lines, got 46`). `src/rebar/_snapshot/janitor.py:345-360` has the same mkdir guard.
4. Rename of a directory holding an open file: `test_snapshot_cache.py::test_open_reader_survives_eviction_then_relookup_misses` renames a live snapshot entry while a reader holds a file in it (`:159`, WinError 5). Windows forbids that rename; the product already handles it, `_evict` returns 0 and keeps the entry (`src/rebar/_snapshot/janitor.py:210-213`), so the reader is safe. The test encodes POSIX delete-on-last-close only.
5. Deleting a process's cwd: `test_detached_child_cwd.py::test_durable_cwd_never_raises_when_the_callers_own_directory_is_gone` rmtrees its own cwd (WinError 32). Windows never lets a directory in use as a cwd be deleted, so the state the test reaches cannot occur there.
6. Hidden `.git` file: `test_copied_worktree_guard.py:165` rewrites a linked worktree's `.git` file with `write_text` (`[Errno 13] Permission denied`). Git for Windows marks `.git` hidden (`core.hideDotFiles`), and `CreateFile(CREATE_ALWAYS)` on a hidden file fails with access denied.
7. `tests/scripts/reducer/test_reducer_cache.py::test_cache_invalidated_on_file_deletion` failed 1 of 3 on an mtime equality assertion that main has since replaced with an inode/content check (bug d45f-229f-effe-4cf8, `:201-206`).
